messages:
Alex P.: Quick heads-up — SDK v2.1 cutoff is 12:00 PT tomorrow. We need: docs, sample apps, quickstarts, and changelog PRs merged by then. Who can own the remaining items?

Maria V.: I can own sample-apps (web + node). I'll pick up the android wrapper PR if someone flags it for me. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/318 :thumbsup:

Ben C.: Docs: I pushed the final changelog entry in #460 but need one more editorial pass. @Alex P. can you approve the changelog wording?

Alex P.: Taking a look now. Ben, small nit in the first bullet — can you clarify the batching example?

Ben C.: Fixed. Also added a quick note on downgrade fallbacks. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/v2.1/changes#downgrade-fallbacks

Sasha R.: Packaging e2e is failing on macOS runners, looks like a zstd mismatch in the wheel build. Error excerpt: "ERROR: failed to build wheel for rw-inference-sdk: zstd version mismatch"

Alex P.: @Sasha R. can you open a quick-run ticket and tag eng-runtime? This is a blocker for the dedicated deploy samples.

Sasha R.: Filed: https://issues.redwood.ai/infra/789 — added logs and stacktrace. Assigning to @eng-runtime-team.

Maria V.: For sample-apps, web + node are green, android wrapper needs a minor interface change in SDK (rename sendRequest -> send). @Sasha R. is that the zstd fix only or can you take the interface change too?

Sasha R.: I can do the interface rename in the SDK, but it touches the client adapter used by eng-runtime tests. ETA: today EOD. Will push a small compat shim:```
// compatibility shim
function send(req) { return sendRequest(req); }
```

Alex P.: Great. @Jules (release-bot) can we get CI gating check results for all release PRs? Need pass status before cutoff.

Jules (release-bot): CI summary — sample-apps/#318: ✅, docs/#460: ✅ (lint), sdk/#502: ❌ (e2e macOS zstd), quickstarts/#29: ✅

Maria V.: I'll hold merging sample-apps until SDK e2e is green to avoid a broken sample. If Sasha's shim lands today we should be fine.

Ben C.: DocsBot flagged one broken code sample in quickstarts — formatting issue in the Python snippet. I'll patch now (#461).

DocsBot: Note — code sample failure detected in quickstarts/py/getting_started.md line 42. Suggest running `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt` before the snippet.

Sasha R.: Pushed sdk/#502 fix (compat shim + rebuilt wheel). Rerunning CI.

Jules (release-bot): Updated CI — sdk/#502: ✅. All release PRs now passing except editorial review on docs which Ben is handling.

Ben C.: Editorial done and merged (#460). Changelog final: "v2.1 — batching improvements, downgrade fallback, packaging fixes."

Alex P.: OK team — ownership summary before cutoff: Maria -> sample-apps merges, Ben -> docs/changelog merge (done), Sasha -> SDK compat + packaging (done), I'll do final release smoke and tag the release. If nothing else, we merge at 11:45 PT to allow rollback window. :eyes: :shipit:

Maria V.: Sounds good. I'll post a merge note with the sample-apps release checklist once merged.

Sasha R.: Posting a short postmortem note in the sdk PR about the zstd issue and host-specific wheel builds for future.

Alex P.: Thanks everyone. If any last-minute blockers ping this thread; otherwise I'll cut the release at 11:45 PT.

Maria V.: One last ask — can platform/eng-oncall confirm there's capacity for a hotfix deploy window tonight if we need it?

Alex P.: I pinged eng-oncall separately. Good catch.

(End of thread)
